text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Things were hectic before and after the 
on-site inspection, but reaching this 
level despite all that is quite an 
achievement.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
It all comes down to how much prep you can 
cram in before spring~

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Still, we've got the roadmap now. All 
that's left is to quickly turn it into 
something tangible. Speed is everything 
for stuff like this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'll need you to run around even 
more than before, Trainer. This is where 
the real critical moment for 'DREAMS' 
begins.
